text_block_list.text:
Having gone through the entire training 
menu, just as I was about to start packing 
up...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It's too early to pack up and 
leave! After all, today is 
Ichiryumanbaibi—a day of tenfold fortune☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Written as 'a single grain yielding 
ten-thousandfold,' it's Ichiryu Manbai-bi!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ichiryumanbaibi is a super lucky day, you 
know!♪ If you take on something wishing 
for your efforts to multiply 
ten-thousandfold, you'll have mega good 
luck!☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer! I'd love to do some extra 
training today☆ Come on, please?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's get right to it! Rickey☆ 
Lucky☆ Ten-Thousand-Fold Training☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's definitely another way to 
look at it!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Since we have this chance, we should do 
something special to really take good care 
of our bodies, right...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I know! The public bath nearby has a foot 
bath corner! Trainer, want to go check it 
out together?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"In feng shui, balancing the inside of 
your body and the flow of qi is super 
important too! Footbaths improve blood 
circulation, so they're totally ideal for 
feng shui☆"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: And so, let's head to the footbath~♪
